invariants.rationale: idPfx is likely used as a prefix for IDs, so a non-null value is typically required.
recordItr is an Iterator expected to be used for insert, so it should not be null.
If the iterator has at least one element, that element should not be null.
A non-empty idPfx is likely required for constructing unique record IDs.
recordItr must be a valid Iterator if it has contents.
